oxsum dashboard placeholder

This is the committed stand-in for the React bundle so rust-embed has a web/dist folder on a fresh checkout. It is not the dashboard.

Build the real bundle before serving /app:

cd web && npm run build

The release Dockerfile runs that build in the frontend stage, so an image build never serves this page. A bare cargo build --release without the bundle does — every hashed asset it points at is intentionally absent.
